lines.text: Many learners say: She is very taller than me.
Better: She is much taller than me.
Much! He is much older than me.

data.wrong: She is very taller than me.
data.right: She is much taller than me.

native.tip: Người Việt hay nghĩ đến “rất”, nên dễ nói “very taller”, nhưng khi so sánh hơn thì tiếng Anh dùng “much”.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “She is very taller than me.” không? 📏 Khi so sánh hơn, hãy dùng “much”: “She is much taller than me.” Nghe cô Ama đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “much.” Hãy nói to một câu so sánh hai người bạn biết, có “much” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.hook: How do you say “taller by a lot”?
en.tip: Learners often use “very” here, but English uses “much” before words like taller.
en.caption: Do you often say this? “She is very taller than me.” To compare, use “much”: “She is much taller than me.” Listen to Ama read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
